# Effects Managers {#effects-managers}

![][image1]

## Haptics Manager {#haptics-manager}

The Haptic Manager orchestrates device vibration in response to haptic events emitted by the Web App. The primary handler lives in the KMP layer, which forwards platform-specific commands to the native iOS/Android APIs to trigger tailored patterns. While basic vibration can be initiated from the Web, it’s limited; implementing haptics natively unlocks richer, device-optimized sequences (intensity, timing, cadence) that enhance tactile feedback and the overall player experience.

### Haptic Web Processor Subscribers {#haptic-web-processor-subscribers}

##### OnUserReadyEvent {#onuserreadyevent}

```kotlin
/** Indicates that the user is ready. */
data class OnUserReadyEvent(val data: DeviceEvent.UserReady)

data class UserReady(
    val preferences: Preferences, // The user's preferences for music, sound effects, and vibrations
    val user: User, // The user object containing userId
  )

  // Data class for the "preferences" field
 data class Preferences(
    val music: Boolean, // Whether music is enabled
    val soundEffects: Boolean, // Whether sound effects are enabled
    val vibrations: Boolean, // Whether vibrations are enabled
  )

  // Data class for the "user" field
  data class User(
    val userId: String, // The user's unique ID
    val userName: String, // the User's Unique username
    val legacyUserId: Int?, // the User's Legacy ID
    val brazeExternalId: String, // The Braze analytics user id
  )
```

#### Haptic Manager Handlers {#haptic-manager-handlers}

##### onUserReadyHandler {#onuserreadyhandler}

```kotlin
/** User ready → seed haptic prefs from web settings. */
@Subscribe(threadMode = ThreadMode.MAIN)
fun onUserReadyHandler(event: OnUserReadyEvent) {
  val enabled = event.data.preferences.vibrations
  logger.i(TAG, "OnUserReadyEvent: haptics=$enabled")
  hapticPreferences = HapticPreferences(isHapticsEnabled = enabled)
  logger.d(TAG, "Haptic preferences set: $hapticPreferences")
}
```

fun onSetHapticFeedbackSettingHandler(event: OnSetHapticFeedbackSettingEvent) {
  logger.d(TAG, "OnUpdateHapticFeedbackSettingEvent: enabled=${event.enabled}")
  setHapticFeedbackSetting(event.enabled)
}

#### Haptic Manager Delegates {#haptic-manager-delegates}

##### onSetHapticFeedbackSetting {#onsethapticfeedbacksetting}

```kotlin
/**
 * Updates haptic feedback; if [enabled] is null, toggles the current setting.
 */
private fun setHapticFeedbackSetting(enabled: Boolean?) {
  val current = hapticPreferences.isHapticsEnabled
  val newValue = enabled ?: !current   // null → toggle; otherwise use provided value
  val mode = if (enabled == null) "toggled" else "set"

  hapticPreferences.isHapticsEnabled = newValue  // single write path
  logger.d(TAG, "Haptic feedback $mode to: $newValue")
}
```

##### onPlayHapticEffect {#onplayhapticeffect}

```kotlin
/**
 * Plays a haptic effect. If [feedbackType] is null or haptics are disabled, no-op.
 */
private fun playHapticEffect(feedbackType: HapticFeedbackType?) {
  // Fast exits keep the happy path small.
  if (feedbackType == null) {
    logger.i(TAG, "Haptic skipped: feedbackType=null (enabled=${hapticPreferences.isHapticsEnabled})")
    return
  }
  if (!hapticPreferences.isHapticsEnabled) {
    logger.d(TAG, "Haptic skipped: user disabled haptics")
    return
  }

  // Obtain a Vibrator in a version-safe way.
  val vibrator: Vibrator? = getVibrator()
  if (vibrator == null || !vibrator.hasVibrator()) {
    logger.w(TAG, "Haptic skipped: no vibrator available")
    return
  }

  val (durationMs, amplitude) = feedbackType.toHapticSpec()

  runCatching {
    val effect = VibrationEffect.createOneShot(durationMs, amplitude)
    vibrator.vibrate(effect)
    logger.d(TAG, "Haptic played: type=$feedbackType duration=${durationMs}ms amplitude=$amplitude")
  }.onFailure { e ->
    logger.e(TAG, "Haptic failed for type=$feedbackType", e)
  }
}

/** Map feedback types to duration/amplitude (values unchanged from original). */
private fun HapticFeedbackType.toHapticSpec(): Pair<Long, Int> = when (this) {
  HapticFeedbackType.LIGHT     -> 20L to 40
  HapticFeedbackType.MEDIUM    -> 40L to 120
  HapticFeedbackType.HEAVY     -> 80L to 255
  HapticFeedbackType.RIGID     -> 20L to 255
  HapticFeedbackType.SOFT      -> 80L to 40
  HapticFeedbackType.SELECTION -> 20L to 40
  HapticFeedbackType.SUCCESS   -> 20L to 40
  HapticFeedbackType.WARNING   -> 80L to 255
  HapticFeedbackType.ERROR     -> 80L to 255
  HapticFeedbackType.FAILURE   -> 40L to 120
}

/** Prefer VibratorManager on API 31+, else fall back to Vibrator service. */
private fun getVibrator(): Vibrator? {
  return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
    mainActivity.getSystemService(VibratorManager::class.java)?.defaultVibrator
  } else {
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    mainActivity.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as? Vibrator
  }
}
```

## Audio Manager  {#audio-manager}

![][image2]

The Audio Manager orchestrates platform music at the Wrapper layer to keep playback consistent through loading screens and transitions where Web-only audio can drop out, preserving immersion. The Web App signals the Wrapper to pause and resume music when entering or leaving gameplay, and the Wrapper persists and enforces the player’s audio preferences (e.g., music disabled). For now, sound effects remain in the Web layer because many require user-initiated touch; migrating SFX to the Wrapper is a potential future improvement but would duplicate logic and require tight parity with the Web implementation.

#### Audio Manager Handlers {#audio-manager-handlers}

##### onUserReadyHandler {#onuserreadyhandler-1}

```kotlin
/** Seed audio prefs from user settings, broadcast state, and sync playback. */
fun onUserReadyHandler(event: OnUserReadyEvent) {
  val musicEnabled = event.data.preferences.music

  audioPreferences = AudioPreferences(
    isMusicEnabled = musicEnabled,
    musicSelection = MusicType.AMBIENT_MUSIC_1.type
  )
  logger.d(TAG, "Audio prefs seeded: enabled=$musicEnabled, selection=${audioPreferences.musicSelection}")

  // Notify listeners and update playback to match the preference.
  eventBus.post(OnSetIsMusicEnabledEvent(musicEnabled))
  setAmbientMusic(isPaused = !musicEnabled)
}
```

##### onUserLogoutHandler {#onuserlogouthandler}

```kotlin
/** Logout → enable ambient music per current behavior. */
fun onUserLogoutHandler(event: OnUserLogoutEvent) {
  logger.d(TAG, "OnUserLogoutEvent")
  onUpdateAmbientMusicSetting(true)
}
```

##### onPlayingResponsiveWebGameHandler {#onplayingresponsivewebgamehandler}

```kotlin
/** Responsive web game state → allow/resume ambient music only when not playing. */
fun onPlayingResponsiveWebGameHandler(event: OnPlayingResponsiveWebGameEvent) {
  loggger.d(TAG, "OnPlayingResponsiveWebGameEvent: isPlaying=${event.isPlaying}")
  if (event.isPlaying) return

  allowMusicUpdates = true
  setAmbientMusic(isPaused = false)
}
```

##### onSetLoadingStateHandler {#onsetloadingstatehandler}

```kotlin
 /** Loading progress → pause ambient music once threshold is reached; lock updates. */ 
fun onSetLoadingStateHandler(event: onSetLoadingStateEvent) {
  val reachedStop = event.loadProgress >= STOP_MUSIC_LOADING_PERCENTAGE
  logger.d(
    TAG,
    "OnLoadingChangedEvent: progress=${event.loadProgress}, reachedStop=$reachedStop (threshold=$STOP_MUSIC_LOADING_PERCENTAGE)"
  )
  if (!reachedStop) return

  pauseAmbientMusic()
  allowMusicUpdates = false
}
```

##### onActivityLifeCycleHandler {#onactivitylifecyclehandler}

```kotlin
/** Activity lifecycle → pause/resume ambient music based on app pause + music pref. */
fun onActivityLifeCycleEvent(event: OnActivityLifeCycleEvent) {
  val musicEnabled = audioPreferences.isMusicEnabled ?: preferencesManager.getIsMusicEnabled()
  val isPaused = event.isPaused || !musicEnabled
  logger.d(TAG, "OnActivityLifeCycleEvent: paused=${event.isPaused}, musicEnabled=$musicEnabled -> isPaused=$isPaused")
  setAmbientMusic(isPaused = isPaused)
}
```

#### Audio Manager Delegates {#audio-manager-delegates}

##### setAmbientMusicSetting {#setambientmusicsetting}

```kotlin
/**
 * Enables/disables ambient music; if [enabled] is null, toggles the current state.
 */
private fun onUpdateAmbientMusicSetting(enabled: Boolean?) {
  val current = audioPreferences.isMusicEnabled ?: preferencesManager.getIsMusicEnabled()
  val newValue = enabled ?: !current

  audioPreferences.isMusicEnabled = newValue
  eventBus.post(OnSetIsMusicEnabledEvent(newValue))
  logger.d(TAG, "Ambient music enabled=$newValue")

  if (newValue) {
    onStartAmbientMusic()
  } else {
    stopAmbientMusic()
  }
}
```

##### setAmbientMusicSelection {#setambientmusicselection}

```kotlin
/** Updates the ambient music selection and (re)starts playback. */
private fun onSetAmbientMusicSelection(musicType: MusicType) {
  val previous = audioPreferences.musicSelection
  audioPreferences.musicSelection = musicType.type
  logger.d(TAG, "Ambient music selection: $previous -> ${musicType.type}")
  onStartAmbientMusic() // will switch tracks or resume as needed
}
```

##### setAmbientMusic {#setambientmusic}

```kotlin
/**
 * Updates ambient music based on pause state and current game status.
 * - If no player and not paused → startAmbientMusic()
 * - If player exists:
 *   - paused → pauseAmbientMusic()
 *   - not paused:
 *       - if updates not allowed → ignore and return
 *       - else → resumeAmbientMusic()
 * After handling, if Unity is playing, disallow future updates.
 */
private fun onSetAmbientMusic(isPaused: Boolean) {
  logger.d(TAG, "onUpdateAmbientMusic(player=$mediaPlayer, isPaused=$isPaused)")

  val player = mediaPlayer
  if (player == null) {
    if (!isPaused) {
      logger.d(TAG, "onUpdateAmbientMusic -> startAmbientMusic()")
      onStartAmbientMusic()
    }
  } else {
    if (isPaused) {
      logger.d(TAG, "onUpdateAmbientMusic -> pauseAmbientMusic()")
      pauseAmbientMusic()
    } else {
      if (!allowMusicUpdates) {
        logger.d(TAG, "onUpdateAmbientMusic -> ignored (updates not allowed)")
        return
      }
      logger.d(TAG, "onUpdateAmbientMusic -> resumeAmbientMusic()")
      resumeAmbientMusic()
    }
  }

  if (unityManager.isPlayingGame) {
    allowMusicUpdates = false
  }
}
```

##### startAmbientMusic {#startambientmusic}

```kotlin
/** Plays the selected ambient music using MediaPlayer (creates player if needed). */
private fun onStartAmbientMusic() {
  // Honor user pref (nullable flag falls back to stored pref)
  val isAmbientOn = audioPreferences.isMusicEnabled ?: preferencesManager.getIsMusicEnabled()
  if (!isAmbientOn) {
    logger.d(TAG, "Ambient music disabled; skipping start")
    return
  }

  // Resolve track resource
  val resId = when (audioPreferences.musicSelection) {
    MusicType.AMBIENT_MUSIC_1.type -> R.raw.ambient_music_1
    MusicType.AMBIENT_MUSIC_2.type -> R.raw.ambient_music_2
    MusicType.AMBIENT_MUSIC_3.type -> R.raw.ambient_music_3
    else                           -> R.raw.ambient_music_1 // default
  }

  // Ensure player exists and is configured
  val player = mediaPlayer ?: MediaPlayer().apply {
    isLooping = true
    setAudioAttributes(
      AudioAttributes.Builder()
        .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
        .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_GAME)
        .build()
    )
  }.also { mediaPlayer = it }

  if (currentMusicResId != resId) {
    // Switching tracks: stop (if needed) → reset → set data source → prepare → start
    runCatching {
      if (player.isPlaying) player.stop()
      player.reset()
      mainActivity.resources.openRawResourceFd(resId).use { afd ->
        player.setDataSource(afd.fileDescriptor, afd.startOffset, afd.length)
      }
      player.prepare()
      player.start()
      currentMusicResId = resId
      logger.d(TAG, "Ambient music started (resId=$resId)")
    }.onFailure { e ->
      logger.e(TAG, "Failed to start ambient music (resId=$resId)", e)
    }
  } else if (!player.isPlaying) {
    // Same track selected: just resume
    runCatching {
      player.start()
      logger.d(TAG, "Ambient music resumed (resId=$resId)")
    }.onFailure { e ->
      logger.e(TAG, "Failed to resume ambient music (resId=$resId)", e)
    }
  }
}
```

##### resumeAmbientMusic {#resumeambientmusic}

```kotlin
/** Resumes ambient music if currently paused. */
private fun resumeAmbientMusic() {
  val player = mediaPlayer ?: return
  if (player.isPlaying) return

  logger.d(TAG, "Resuming ambient music")
  runCatching { player.start() }
    .onFailure { e -> logger.e(TAG, "Error resuming music", e) }
}
```

##### pauseAmbientMusic {#pauseambientmusic}

```kotlin
/** Pauses ambient music if currently playing. */
private fun pauseAmbientMusic() {
  val player = mediaPlayer ?: return
  if (!player.isPlaying) return

  logger.d(TAG, "Pausing ambient music")
  runCatching { player.pause() }
    .onFailure { e -> logger.e(TAG, "Error pausing music", e) }
}
```

##### stopAmbientMusic {#stopambientmusic}

```kotlin
/** Stops playback (if playing), resets the player, and clears the current music resource id. */
private fun stopAmbientMusic() {
  val player = mediaPlayer ?: return

  // Stop only when playing, then reset to uninitialized (matches original behavior).
  runCatching {
    if (player.isPlaying) player.stop()
  }.onFailure { e -> logger.e(TAG, "Error stopping music", e) }

  runCatching { player.reset() }
    .onFailure { e -> logger.e(TAG, "Error resetting MediaPlayer", e) }

  currentMusicResId = null
  logger.d(TAG, "Ambient music stopped; player reset; currentMusicResId cleared")
}
```
